edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC6 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given a request to a provided operation of rwb-asset for "AST-2026-000521"
    When the request carries no valid credential
    Then the answer is 401 with the platform envelope and nothing changes
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002 when the role does not hold the Asset and disposal right, and nothing changes
    Then the answer is 404 for a requested resource that does not exist, with the platform envelope; the identifier rule is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4033-APP-AC7)

  Scenario: AC7 Consumed contract does not answer inside 2 s, or its breaker is open (section 5 X5)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer inside 2 s for "RC-2026-000521"
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's schedule and nothing is committed
    Then no move is answered and the caller sees 503 with the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC8 Consumed call fails (section 5 X5)
    Given the rwb-payment contract mock fails the auto-debit request for "RC-2026-000521" with a failure code Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4033-APP-AC8)
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then nothing is committed, no mandate is sent and no move is answered

  Scenario: AC9 Status change the model does not allow (section 5 X3 and X7)
    Given the asset "AST-2026-000521" carries holding status "SOLD"
    When the rental is asked for
    Then the request is refused with 409 and nothing is written
